boundary: This proves a packaged deployment-service trust-root rollover for the Control Plane, Worker, Access Gateway and Admin Web against real PostgreSQL and Kubernetes in a task-owned local kind cluster, plus a fixed-digest Debian customer node on the same OrbStack Docker engine. The kubectl v1.33.9 client reported an unsupported version-skew warning against the v1.37.0 server, but the complete Helm, API, browser, mTLS, SSH and cleanup flow passed. The chart uses Recreate and this is not zero-downtime evidence. The node declared only exec and no Sandbox workload ran. This does not cover cert-manager or another external issuer, public ingress, HA, external PostgreSQL/S3, OIDC/JWKS, master-key, access-grant-key or SSH-host-key rotation, real Provider credentials, published images, or the full BASE-ADMIN-V1 acceptance matrix. Earlier OrbStack Kubernetes attempts failed before or during the flow with API EOF/deadline errors and are not counted as evidence. The candidate came from a dirty local tree and is not BASE-READY.
